name: chart-expert
description: Expert guidance on producing high-quality charts with the Charting component (TDA_Charting) — deciding when to visualize, choosing the right chart type for the question, mapping fields, and avoiding visualization anti-patterns.
author: Uderia
use_cases: Deciding whether a data result deserves a chart or reads better as a table
Choosing the chart type that fits the user's question shape
Mapping data columns to the correct visual roles
Producing top/bottom-N charts with sort and row limit
Avoiding visualization anti-patterns (overloaded pies, single-value charts)
